text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. I understand you've been experiencing a delay in the onset of your periods and have a history of bone fragility. Could you describe your current height and any specific physical features you feel are unusual, such as your neck or arms?

speaker: Patient
text: 16-year-old female. The patient has not experienced menarche. She was noted to have partial labial fusion and clitoromegaly at birth. The patient's mother reports that during pregnancy she had abnormal hair growth on her chin. The patient has a history of severe acne and has sustained fractures following minor trauma. She is currently on oral isotretinoin and an oral contraceptive.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the history of virilization at birth, maternal hirsutism, and bone fragility, I suspect an adrenal enzyme defect. REQUEST TEST: 17-hydroxyprogesterone_level, Cortisol_level, ACTH_level.

speaker: Doctor
